dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: It's okay. It's not an emergency. No need to bother anyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: And she should be able to take care of herself on her own.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: But you, you'd better watch yourself. In this place, quite a lot of people come and go... if you know what I mean.
